name: @droneey/constitution-workspace
description: The workspace of the Droneey Constitution: its rules and the tools that hold them.

scripts.lint:check: biome check --error-on-warnings && biome check --error-on-warnings --config-path=biome.apps-site.jsonc apps/site && uv run --locked ruff check packages/python-check packages/mutation-check/languages/python
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write && biome check --write --config-path=biome.apps-site.jsonc apps/site && uv run --locked ruff check --fix packages/python-check packages/mutation-check/languages/python
scripts.type:check: tsc -b && uv run --locked ty check --config-file .droneey/constitution/presets/python/ty/self.toml packages/python-check packages/mutation-check/languages/python
scripts.test: bun run --filter '*' test && for package in packages/python-check packages/mutation-check/languages/python; do uv run --locked --directory "$package" --project "$PWD" pytest --cov || exit 1; done
scripts.build: bun build --target=bun ./packages/constitution/src/entrypoints/blocks-check/main.ts --outfile packages/constitution/tools/constitution/dist/blocks-check.js && bun build --target=bun --packages=external ./packages/mutation-check/languages/typescript/src/main.ts --outdir packages/constitution/tools/mutation-check/dist && bun build --target=bun ./packages/mutation-check/languages/typescript/src/runner.ts ./packages/mutation-check/languages/typescript/src/ignorers.ts --outdir packages/constitution/tools/mutation-check/dist && mkdir -p packages/constitution/tools/python-check/dist packages/constitution/tools/mutmut-check/dist && python3 -m zipapp packages/python-check/src -m droneey_python_check.main:main -o packages/constitution/tools/python-check/dist/python-check.pyz && python3 -m zipapp packages/mutation-check/languages/python/src -m droneey_mutation_check.main:main -o packages/constitution/tools/mutmut-check/dist/mutmut-check.pyz
scripts.mutation:check: bun run --filter '*' --sequential mutation:check && for package in packages/python-check packages/mutation-check/languages/python; do uv run --locked --directory "$package" --project "$PWD" mutmut-check || exit 1; done
scripts.mutation:all: bun run --filter '*' --sequential mutation:all && for package in packages/python-check packages/mutation-check/languages/python; do uv run --locked --directory "$package" --project "$PWD" mutmut-check all || exit 1; done
scripts.secrets:check: betterleaks git . --redact --no-banner && betterleaks git . --pre-commit --redact --no-banner && betterleaks git . --pre-commit --staged --redact --no-banner
scripts.architecture:check: depcruise packages/constitution/src packages/constitution/tests packages/mutation-check/languages/typescript/src --config .dependency-cruiser.mjs && bun run --filter '*' architecture:check
scripts.unused:check: knip --no-config-hints && knip --strict --no-config-hints && for package in packages/python-check packages/mutation-check/languages/python; do uv run --locked --directory "$package" --project "$PWD" vulture || exit 1; done
scripts.format:check: uv run --locked ruff format --check packages/python-check packages/mutation-check/languages/python
scripts.format:fix: uv run --locked ruff format packages/python-check packages/mutation-check/languages/python
scripts.dependencies:check: for package in packages/python-check packages/mutation-check/languages/python; do uv run --locked --directory "$package" --project "$PWD" deptry src || exit 1; done
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint:check && bun run packages:check && bun run type:check && bun run code:check && bun run complexity:check && bun run architecture:check && bun run --parallel test mutation:check && bun run blocks:check && bun run secrets:check && bun run unused:check && bun run dependencies:check && bun run audit:check && bun run shell:check && bun run markdown:check && bun run yaml:check && bun run renovate:check
